name: auto-code-review-monorepo
description: One review standard for every coding agent.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test benchmark/test/*.test.cjs tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present && node --test --experimental-test-coverage benchmark/test/*.test.cjs tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run validate
